title: Chain of custody form
description: Evidence chain of custody form (NIST sample form style): case header, item descriptions, collection details, and a transfer log of who released and received the items, signed by hand. Used for digital evidence (drives, workstations, logs), election materials (memory cards, ballot containers), and recovered drones.

org.description: Organization keeping custody (defaults to the project's organization)

examples: Evidence Chain of Custody Tracking Form

description.description: What the item is, with make and model
examples: Dell OptiPlex 7090 workstation, HMI-02, black tower

serial.description: Serial number or other unique identifier

examples: Water Treatment Plant control room, 1200 River Rd, Milford
Suspected unauthorized remote access to plant HMI

releasedBy.description: Person releasing the items (signed by hand)

receivedBy.description: Person receiving the items (signed by hand)

purpose.description: Reason for transfer or storage location
examples: Forensic imaging - FBI Cleveland Field Office

notes.description: Remarks (condition, power state, who else handled it)
examples: Collected powered on; RAM capture taken before shutdown.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above and below the form
